jobs_results.title: Programador .NET Core
jobs_results.description:
En The Wise Seeker nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a Programador .NET Core con experiencia y que comprenda la lógica del código para cliente final para empresa ubicada en Pamplona.

Lugar: Pamplona

Sector: Consultoría de IT

Funciones
• Diseñar, crear e implementar software.
• Ofrecer soporte a productos generados con el framework . NET.
• Automatizar los procesos.

Requisitos
• Imprescindible que sepa desarrollar en NET Core y comprenda la lógica del código.
• Buena capacidad analítica.
• Buena capacidad de resolución de problemas.
• Experiencia programando/desarrollando aplicaciones.
• Adaptabilidad a cambios tecnológicos y metodológicos
• 2.5 años de experiencia mínimo.

Deseable
• 2-3 años de experiencia.
• Conocimiento del ecosistema .Net/dotNet y el lenguaje C#.
• Angular/React
• Conocimientos de gestión de BBDD y lenguaje SQL sobre Microsoft SQL Server.
• Conocimiento de control de código mediante Git.

Competencias
• Buena capacidad analítica.
• Buena capacidad de... resolución de problemas.
• Experiencia programando/desarrollando aplicaciones.
• Adaptabilidad a cambios tecnológicos y metodológicos.

Beneficios
• Contrato indefinido
• Jornada completa
• Salario según valía del candidato
• Híbrido en Pamplona

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Senior .net y Azure
jobs_results.description:
Come join us

Uniéndote a Avanade como Desarrollador/a Senior .net y Azure, participarás en el desarrollo de aplicaciones con Azure y AWS. Formarás parte de un entorno dinámico, en colaboración con clientes para resolver sus problemas. Alimenta tu pasión por el aprendizaje e innovación continua, generando una experiencia informática integrada y desbloqueando oportunidades ilimitados de crecimiento. Together We do what matters

Skills and experiences

Experiencia en desarrollo de software bajo tecnología .NET Core Experiencia con herramientas ETL y bbdd SQL o Snowflake entre otros. Conocimiento de arquitectura de datos y diseño de flujos. Experiencia en aplicaciones basadas en microservicios y APIs. Inglés alto, ya que formarás parte de un proyecto internacional.

About you

Trabajo en equipo y buena comunicación. Gran capacidad para solucionar problemas, perseverante y enfocado en la calidad. Autodidacta. Mentalidad innovadora.

What you'll do

Implementación de proyectos NET CORE, en... entornos Cloud con Azure o AWS Participarás en proyectos de arquitectura e integración de datos y diseño de flujos. Asegurar que los componentes cumplan con los requisitos y objetivos de rendimiento. Resolver problemas y optimizar el proceso de entrega de software. Crear documentación técnica y operativa de usuario final.

Enjoy your career

Algunas cosas a cerca de trabajar en Avanade Oportunidad de trabajar para uno de los mejores reconocidos Partners de Microsoft (14 años seguidos) con un desarrollo y formación adaptado a tus necesidades (minimo de 80 horas al año para formación y certificaciones, Acceso completo a recursos tecnologicos y de otras habilidades de manera global. Employee Benefits at Avanade | Avanade

Trayendo tus fortalezas y habilidades a Avanade, conseguirás una experiencia diferenciadora, con aprendizaje ilimitado y ambicioso crecimiento. Estamos construyendo una cultura diversa e inclusiva, llegando a ser cada vez más innovadores y creativos, ayudándonos a ofrecer mejores soluciones a nuestros clientes y comunidades. Te unirás a una comunidad inteligente, con colaboradores que te ayudarán a avanzar, mentorizándote y guiándote y, apoyándose en tu trayectoria. Formarás parte de una compañía diseñada específicamente para promover soluciones tecnológicas de vanguardia y, comprometidos a mejorar la forma en la que los humanos trabajamos, interactuamos y vivimos. Está todo aquí, echa un vistazo! Trabajamos para proporcionar una cultura diversa e inclusiva con un profundo sentido de pertenencia en todos nuestros empleados/as. jobs_results.title: Back End Developer (.Net)
jobs_results.description:
Enreach is a leading European provider of converged contact solutions for businesses. It provides intelligent communication technology and integrated modern telecom services that enable agile organization.

Enreach for Enterprises is a business unit of Enreach that targets corporations and enterprises based in Europe, offering modern, enterprise-level cloud-based telephony and communications solutions. The Enreach for Enterprises business unit has more than 100 colleagues in the Nordic countries.

In 2024, the objective is to expand Enreach for Enterprises organization and grow sales in key Enreach countries within Europe. This new development and growth phase brings new opportunities to the technology and R&D organization. We drive continuous product and technology innovations, including further development of global cloud-based microservices and modern cloud architectures.

Enreach for Enterprises product development team has developed a data analytics platform. We are now... modernizing and improving our product portfolio by developing the Voice Analytics platform further including replacing some of the existing components, expanding current capabilities and introducing AI. Therefore we are now strengthening our product development team with two new Backend Software Developers (.Net/C#).

More specifically, your tasks will include:
• Play a key role in developing exciting new features inside the Analytics application and integrating them into our core system.
• Work in close cooperation with a team of product developers, data analytics team, QA, architects and product managers
• Produce good quality code according to our DevOps and agile product development practices
• Produce technical documentation as required
• Contribute as third-line technical support for code-related customer issues

What you´ll bring:
• A minimum of 3-4 years working as a software developer in the backend
• Knowhow on modern backend software development (e.g. Python, .NET/C#, Java, Rust, Go)
• Knowhow on databases (e.g. MSQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB)
• Experience in working with different messaging/data event systems (e.g. Rabbit MQ, Kafka)
• Experience in data analytics platforms is a plus (e.g. Snowflake, Power BI)
• Ability to work independently and in a multi-national team
• Good written and oral communication skills in English
• A proactive and cooperative team member
• Willingness to learn new technologies and tools and passion to produce high-quality code
• International mindset with respect for diversity

What makes us rock?
• For this position, we offer a permanent contract!
• Our flexible working hours make easier to get a life-work balance ⏰
• We can enjoy 23 days of vacation per year and 1 extra day to participate in any social responsibility activity
• Our bank holidays are flexible. You can enjoy them on the day they fall or exchange them for another day that suits you better 📅
• We have a "hybrid way of working" that allows us to combine working at home and coming to our Malaga office
• At Enreach we believe in personal growth, boosting different trainings and certifications, and offering language lessons (English and Spanish) at work!
• Flexible remuneration (public transport, healthcare insurance, restaurant ticket and kindergarten) is one of the perks that you can enjoy
• Sick leave coverage
• We love to create memorable experiences. We enjoy organizing social events to gather with colleagues a few times per year
• Join the ¨Juernes¨ every last Thursday of the month tasting some pizzas together
• We like to have fun, so in our office you can find a wide range of funny activities such as playing board games, ping pong, table football, video games, playing the guitar, eating fresh fruit, enjoying tasty coffee, or even drinking a beer with colleagues 🎯🎮
• We like to practice sports and outdoor activities together so you are welcome to join🚴

If all of this sounds interesting to you and you would like to be the new member of our family, do not hesitate to apply for the vacancy

jobs_results.title: Senior .Net Software Developer
jobs_results.description:
Senior Software Developers collaborate with Business and Quality Analysts, Designers, Project Managers and more to design software solutions that will create meaningful change for our clients. They listen thoughtfully to understand the context of a business problem and write clean and iterative code to deliver a powerful end result whilst consistently advocating for better engineering practices. By balancing strong opinions with a willingness to find the right answer, Senior Software Developers bring integrity to technology, ensuring all voices are heard.

For a team to thrive, it needs collaboration and room for healthy, respectful debate. Senior Developers are the technologists who cultivate this environment while driving teams toward delivering on an aspirational tech vision and acting as mentors for more junior-level consultants. You will leverage deep technical knowledge to solve complex business problems and proactively assess your team’s health, code quality and nonfunctional... requirements.

Job responsibilities
• You will learn and adopt best practices like writing clean and reusable code using TDD, pair programming and design patterns
• You will use and advocate for continuous delivery practices to deliver high-quality software as well as value to end customers as early as possible
• You will work in collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients
• You will create large-scale distributed systems out of microservices
• You will collaborate with a variety of teammates to build features, design concepts and interactive prototypes and ensure best practices and UX specifications are embedded along the way.
• You will apply the latest technology thinking from our Technology Radar to solve client problems
• You will oversee or take part in the entire cycle of software consulting and delivery from ideation to deployment and everything in between
• You will act as a mentor for less-experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills

Job Qualifications

Technical Skills
• You have a strong knowledge and understanding of .NET technologies
• You have working experience with the AWS development and deployment environment.
• You can skillfully write high-quality, well-tested code and you are comfortable with Object-Oriented programming.
• Comfortability with Agile methods, such as Extreme Programming (XP), Scrum, and/or Kanban.
• Experience relevant to the above-mentioned responsibilities.

Professional Skills
• You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed
• You're resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives
• Strong communication and teamwork skills, dedicated to discovering the most suitable solutions for any given scenario.
• You genuinely enjoy interacting with teammates from across the business and have a knack for communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design and engineering to drive digital innovation. For 30+ years, our clients have trusted our autonomous teams to build solutions that look past the obvious. Here, computer science grads come together with seasoned technologists, self-taught developers, midlife career changers and more to learn from and challenge each other. Career journeys flourish with the strength of our cultivation culture, which has won numerous awards around the world.

Join Thoughtworks and thrive. Together, our extra curiosity, innovation, passion and dedication overcomes ordinary

jobs_results.title: Software Developer (.NET)
jobs_results.description:
About us :

As the European market leader, NEXTLANE develops and delivers digital solutions for the automotive industry by connecting the systems of manufacturers and dealers.

We develop integrated end-to-end software and digital solutions that digitize and simplify the entire automotive customer journey.

Our mission is to empower our clients to boost their business operations and optimize their customer experience through innovative solutions. Our comprehensive software suite revolutionizes every aspect of new and used vehicle sales and management.

📋 Context of the Position :

Nextlane needs a .NET developer, which will be responsible for the evolution, development and maintenance of a CRM product for the automotive sector (for vehicle sales), whose users are all located in Sweden.

They will report to the IT Project Manager. The team will be composed by 4 developers, 1 technical leader and 1 functional tester.

🎯 Your responsibilities :

As a key member of our team, you'll be... responsible for :

Main missions
• Make the technical implementation of the functional requirements, proposing optimized technical solutions.
• Write technical documentation: how the process are implemented, databases tables, diagrams, swaggers, etc.
• Develop, evolution and maintenance of the CRM.
• Guide the team in the resolution of day-to-day technical problems.
• Review the commits and technical documentation of the other teammates.
• Deployment of versions.
• Communicate with Project Manager and Technical Leader on a frequent basis.

Main interfaces with other teams / departments
• Product team: to assist in the technical analysis of functional proposals and their feasibility.
• Support team to coordinate the resolution of complex incidents.

🕵️ What we are looking for :

Technical Skills
• +2 years of programming experience in the technologies involved.
• Have worked with agile methodologies.
• Expert in the main technologies:
• C# .Net,, PostgreSQL (Ability to develop advanced and complex solutions in these technologies in an optimal way).
• HTML5
• REST, Web Services, SOAP, JSON, XML.
• Input and output files: CSV, XML, Excel, PDF generation.
• Clean code work is highly valued

Soft skills
• To be very careful with the quality of the work
• Partnership

Languages
• Fluent English

🤝 Our Recruitment Process:

1. 30-minute call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.

2. Technical test.

3. Technical discussion to validate your technical skills. You will also meet with your Project Manager to discuss the project and have the opportunity to resolve any questions or concerns you may have.

Join us and be part of the Nextlane adventure that is shaping the future of the automotive industry!

💎 Our Advantages

We value flexibility and trust within our corporate culture, offering benefits that reflect our commitment to our teams:

🏡 Possibility to telework up to 3 days a week!

🤝 €600 referral bonus for each talent you capture. (after the 6-month tiral period).

🍱 Flexible Remuneration (COBEE).

👩 ⚕️ Medical Insurance (Adeslas).

📒 Access to a dedicated internal training platform for continuous learning.

🌴 23 days of vacation. Intensive day July and August.

🤝 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Belonging:

We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued in the workplace. We believe that the company and its culture are strongest when they are made up of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities. If you are a person with a disability and need help, please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support and make any adjustments that may be necessary.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

🌍 What does it mean to work at Nextlane?

Join a young and fast-growing company, where you can work on new and ambitious projects.

International and multicultural environment.

Collaboration between colleagues.

We truly believe that Nextlane is a great place to work and develop your talent! Sign up for our offer and find out why

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador .net / vb.net -100 remoto
jobs_results.description:
¿Cómo vas a afrontar tu desarrollo profesional?

En Arelance sabemos que las personas son el activo más importante dentro de una empresa, por ello invertimos tiempo y dedicación para encontrar los mejores profesionales de hoy y de mañana. No empleamos menos tiempo en escoger en nuestros clientes los mejores proyectos con proyección y en donde aportar realmente valor.
Formarás parte de un entorno cercano, joven y dinámico en donde deberás estar preparado para poder adaptarte a los continuos cambios que supone trabajar en una compañía cuya constante es la Innovación, orientación al logro y el crecimiento profesional.
Nuestro objetivo: maximizar tu Talento y tu entorno laboral.

En este momento buscamos incorporar a profesionales con experiencia en desarrollo de Aplicaciones .NET, para la definición de arquitectura software y desarrollo de nuevos proyectos en software de RRHH.

¿Qué buscamos?
- Programadores/as de aplicaciones .NET (VB.NET, SQL Server) con experiencia mínima 2... años.

Tecnologías requeridas:
- Experiencia en programación orientada a objetos
- Experiencia en lenguaje VB.NET
- Experiencia en conocimiento de base de datos Microsoft SQL Server
- Experiencia en desarrollo de aplicaciones WinForms

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
- Incorporación a un proyecto en continuo desarrollo (incorporación en remoto por la situación actual, hasta vuelta a oficina).
- Integración en un proyecto colaborativo en expansión.

Si estás interesado/a en una gran oportunidad como ésta, inscríbete! Queremos conocerte

jobs_results.title: .NET DEVELOPER (5/7 years)
jobs_results.description:
Estamos buscando un desarrollador de C#/ReactJS con experiencia más allá de la programación. Esta persona desempeñará un papel fundamental en la construcción y mantenimiento de los microservicios de la empresa, garantizando el desarrollo de una lógica sólida del lado del servidor y respuestas de alto rendimiento a las solicitudes externas. Un interés marcado en explorar la lógica del dominio y optimizar el código es esencial. Como miembro del equipo, se espera que colabores con tus compañeros aportando las mejores prácticas en el desarrollo de C#, .NET y TypeScript.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

- Desarrollar, mantener y optimizar el código de C# dentro de nuestra arquitectura de microservicios.
- Desarrollar, mantener y optimizar el código de TypeScript y React en nuestros servicios front-end.
- Diseñar e implementar APIs.
- Optimizar el rendimiento de las aplicaciones para despliegues de producción a gran escala.
- Liderar revisiones de código para garantizar el mantenimiento... de un código de alta calidad y fomentar el intercambio de conocimientos.
- Solucionar problemas y depurar para optimizar el rendimiento.
- Investigar los problemas para eliminar cualquier problema futuro y corregir todas las inconsistencias anteriores.
- Desarrollar bibliotecas de código reutilizables para uso posterior.

Habilidades/Experiencia:

- Al menos 2 años de experiencia práctica en desarrollo de C#.
- Al menos 1 año de experiencia práctica en TypeScript y ReactJS.
- Conocimiento profundo de la plataforma .Net y del lenguaje C#.
- Experiencia en Asp.Net WebAPI.
- Competencia en Entity Framework y desarrollo de bases de datos relacionales.
- Experiencia probada liderando un equipo de desarrollo y llevando proyectos a su conclusión.
- Experiencia en desarrollo ágil, especialmente SCRUM (opcional).
- Habilidad demostrada para diseñar y construir sistemas utilizando arquitectura de microservicios o SOA.
- Dominio del inglés es imprescindible.

- Backend:

- La mayoría de nuestros servicios utilizan .Net Core 6. Algunos de ellos utilizan .Net 5.
- NServiceBus
- Azure SQL Server
- WebApi
- EF
- Azure
- Kubernetes

- git | CI/CD - Azure DevOps Terraform mejorado | Notion | Youtrack

Beneficios:

- Desarrolla tu carrera en una de las principales FinTech de Europa.
- Salario competitivo + bonificación.
- Carrera internacional.
- Trabajo híbrido (3 días en la oficina/2 días remoto
